NONE: › belonging to or relating to Ghana or its people
› If someone looks ghastly, they look very ill or very shocked, especially with a very pale face.
一臉病容的；（由於驚嚇）面如死灰的；（尤指）面無血色的

example: Today's newspaper gives all the ghastly details of the murder.
今天的報紙登出了謀殺案的全部細節，令人毛骨悚然。
It was all a ghastly mistake.
I thought her outfit was ghastly.
我覺得她的套裝難看死了。
You look ghastly - are you okay?

C: › a set of steps leading down to a river or lake
向下通往一條河（或一座湖）的一組臺階
› also burning ghat a place at the edge of a river where Hindus cremate (= burn) dead people
› a road or path through mountains
